# GitHub Governance and Automation

This directory contains repository automation, contribution templates, and Copilot standards.

## Contents

- workflows/: CI automation
- ISSUE_TEMPLATE/: issue intake templates
- instructions/: repository-scoped coding instructions
- skills/: reusable engineering skill playbooks
- agents/: review and release playbooks
- copilot-instructions.md: baseline Copilot guidance for this repository

## Maintenance Notes

- Keep templates and instructions aligned with actual project behavior.
- Review CI and dependency automation monthly.
- Replace CODEOWNERS placeholders with real users/teams before enforcement.
